mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 51 degrees under clear skies at Verona Community Park with a waning crescent moon phase.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which serves as a long-term roadmap for city housing, infrastructure, and sustainability over the next decade.

Today you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, attend Art House 360 Thursday nights, or participate in Hop Haus trivia. Looking ahead, we have music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and Puppets in the Park this Saturday.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested following a stolen firearm investigation initiated by the Cottage Grove Police Department.
You can look forward to Double Strawberry as today's flavor of the day, and please note the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
